# This Source Code Form is subject to the terms of the Mozilla Public

---
loader: taskgraph.loader.transform:loader

transforms:
    - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.merge_automation:transforms
    - comm_taskgraph.transforms.merge_automation:transforms
    - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.task:transforms

task-defaults:
    run-on-repo-type: [hg]

tasks:
    merge-automation:
        name: merge-automation
        label: merge-automation
        treeherder:
            symbol: Rel(merge-automation)
            tier: 1
            kind: build
            platform: thunderbird-release/opt
        description: Merge repositories for release management.
        worker-type: lando
        worker:
            implementation: scriptworker-lando
            lando-repo:
                by-project:
                    try:
                        by-behavior:
                            main-to-beta: staging-thunderbird-beta
                            beta-to-release: staging-thunderbird-release
                            release-to-esr: staging-thunderbird-esr153
                            bump-main: staging-thunderbird-main
                            bump-esr153: staging-thunderbird-esr153
                    default:
                        by-behavior:
                            main-to-beta: thunderbird-desktop-beta
                            beta-to-release: thunderbird-desktop-release
                            release-to-esr: thunderbird-desktop-esr153
                            bump-main: thunderbird-desktop-main
                            bump-esr153: thunderbird-desktop-esr153
            dontbuild: false
            actions:
                by-behavior:
                    # This list of behaviours should be kept in sync with
                    # the enum in the merge_automation action
                    bump-main:
                        - main-bump:
                              fetch-version-from: "mail/config/version.txt"
                              version-files:
                                  - filename: "mail/config/version.txt"
                                    version-bump: "major"
                                    new-suffix: "a1"
                                  - filename: "mail/config/version_display.txt"
                                    version-bump: "major"
                                    new-suffix: "a1"
                              replacements:
                                  - - "suite/config/version.txt"
                                    - "{old_suite_version}"
                                    - "{new_suite_version}"
                                  - - "suite/config/version_display.txt"
                                    - "{old_suite_version}"
                                    - "{new_suite_version}"
                              end-tag: "NIGHTLY_{major_version}_END"
                              to-branch: "main"
                              update-clobber-file: false
                    bump-esr153:
                        - esr-bump:
                              fetch-version-from: "mail/config/version.txt"
                              version-files:
                                  - filename: "mail/config/version.txt"
                                    version-bump: "minor"
                                  - filename: "mail/config/version_display.txt"
                                    version-bump: "minor"
                              to-branch: "esr153"
                              update-clobber-file: false
                    main-to-beta:
                        - uplift:
                              fetch-version-from: "mail/config/version.txt"
                              version-files:
                                  - filename: "mail/config/version.txt"
                                    new-suffix: ""
                                  - filename: "mail/config/version_display.txt"
                                    new-suffix: "b1"
                              replacements:
                                  - - "mail/config/mozconfigs/l10n-common"
                                    - "ac_add_options --with-branding=comm/mail/branding/nightly"
                                    - "ac_add_options --enable-official-branding"
                                  - - "suite/config/version.txt"
                                    - "a1"
                                    - ""
                                  - - "suite/config/version_display.txt"
                                    - "a1"
                                    - "b1"
                                  - - "mail/confvars.sh"
                                    - "MOZ_OFFICIAL_BRANDING_DIRECTORY="
                                    - "MOZ_OFFICIAL_BRANDING_DIRECTORY=comm/mail/branding/tb_beta"
                                  - - ".arcconfig"
                                    - THUNDERBIRDDESKTOPMAIN
                                    - THUNDERBIRDDESKTOPBETA
                                  - - ".gecko_rev.yml"
                                    - "GECKO_HEAD_REPOSITORY: https://hg.mozilla.org/mozilla-central"
                                    - "GECKO_HEAD_REPOSITORY: https://hg.mozilla.org/releases/mozilla-beta"
                              base-tag: "BETA_{major_version}_BASE"
                              end-tag: "BETA_{major_version}_END"
                              from-branch: "main"
                              to-branch: "beta"
                              update-clobber-file: false
                              l10n-bump-info:
                                  - name: "Thunderbird l10n changesets"
                                    path: mail/locales/l10n-changesets.json
                                    l10n-repo-url: "https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-l10n"
                                    l10n-repo-target-branch: main
                                    ignore-config:
                                        ja:
                                            - macosx64
                                        ja-JP-mac:
                                            - linux
                                            - linux64
                                            - win32
                                            - win64
                                    platform-configs: [{
                                        "platforms": ["linux", "linux64", "macosx64", "win32", "win64"],
                                        "path": "mail/locales/shipped-locales",
                                    }]
                    beta-to-release:
                        - uplift:
                              fetch-version-from: "mail/config/version.txt"
                              version-files:
                                  - filename: "mail/config/version_display.txt"
                                    new-suffix: ""
                              replacements:
                                  - - "suite/config/version_display.txt"
                                    - "b1"
                                    - ""
                                  - - "mail/confvars.sh"
                                    - "MOZ_OFFICIAL_BRANDING_DIRECTORY=comm/mail/branding/tb_beta"
                                    - "MOZ_OFFICIAL_BRANDING_DIRECTORY=comm/mail/branding/thunderbird"
                                  - - ".arcconfig"
                                    - THUNDERBIRDDESKTOPBETA
                                    - THUNDERBIRDDESKTOPRELEASE
                                  - - ".gecko_rev.yml"
                                    - "GECKO_HEAD_REPOSITORY: https://hg.mozilla.org/releases/mozilla-beta"
                                    - "GECKO_HEAD_REPOSITORY: https://hg.mozilla.org/releases/mozilla-release"
                              base-tag: "RELEASE_{major_version}_BASE"
                              end-tag: "RELEASE_{major_version}_END"
                              from-branch: "beta"
                              to-branch: "release"
                              update-clobber-file: false
                    release-to-esr:
                        - merge-day:
                              fetch-version-from: "mail/config/version.txt"
                              version-files:
                                  - filename: "mail/config/version_display.txt"
                                    new-suffix: "esr"
                              replacements: []
                              end-tag: "ESR_{major_version}_BASE"
                              to-branch: "esr153"
                              update-clobber-file: false

            # Thunderbird-specific gecko revision pinning
            gecko-rev:
                by-behavior:
                    main-to-beta:
                        source: from-branch
                        upstream: mozilla-beta
                        tag: 'FIREFOX_{major_version}_0b1_BUILD\d'
                        base: 'FIREFOX_BETA_{major_version}_BASE'
                    beta-to-release:
                        source: from-branch
                        upstream: mozilla-release
                        tag: 'FIREFOX_{major_version}_0_BUILD\d'
                        base: 'FIREFOX_RELEASE_{major_version}_BASE'
                    release-to-esr:
                        source: to-branch
                        upstream: mozilla-esr153
                        tag: 'FIREFOX_{major_version}_0esr_BUILD\d'
                        base: 'FIREFOX_ESR_{major_version}_BASE'
                    default: null
        run-on-projects: []
        expiration-policy: long
        routes:
            by-level:
                '3':
                    # # Thunderbird Drivers
                    - "notify.matrix-room.!xPTYfLywxFMryjbnJl:mozilla.org.on-pending"
                    - "notify.matrix-room.!xPTYfLywxFMryjbnJl:mozilla.org.on-resolved"
                default:
                    # # Thunderbird Drivers
                    - "notify.matrix-room.!xPTYfLywxFMryjbnJl:mozilla.org.on-pending"
                    - "notify.matrix-room.!xPTYfLywxFMryjbnJl:mozilla.org.on-resolved"
        scopes:
            - "queue:route:notify.matrix-room.*"
        extra:
            notify:
                matrixBody:
                    $let:
                        dry_run:
                            $if: "'dry_run' in task.payload && task.payload.dry_run"
                            then: " (dry run)"
                            else: ""
                    in: "merge-automation task ${task.metadata.name}${dry_run} is now ${status.state}: https://firefox-ci-tc.services.mozilla.com/tasks/${taskId}"
